inlines.v: TRACK'LESS, adjective Having no track; marked by no footsteps; untrodden; as a trackless desert. TRACK'-ROAD, noun [track and road.] A towing-path. TRACK'-SCOUT, noun A boat or vessel employed on the canals in Holland, usually drawn by a horse.
